## PERSONA
You are a customer planning a trip to a new city. You want to book flights and a hotel, then find a bar to enjoy once you arrive.

## USER
{
  "user_id": "USR-0350B121",
  "first_name": "Sarah",
  "last_name": "Miller",
  "email": "sarah.miller772@outlook.com",
  "city": "Asheville",
  "state": "NC",
  "neighborhood": "Downtown Asheville",
  "birthdate": "1996-09-25",
  "payment_wallet": "{\"credit_cards\":[{\"name\":\"Visa\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"9696\"},{\"name\":\"Discover\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"4536\"},{\"name\":\"Mastercard\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"3634\"},{\"name\":\"Diners Club\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"8237\"},{\"name\":\"JCB\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"3910\"},{\"name\":\"American Express\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"9244\"},{\"name\":\"Visa\",\"credit_card_last_four\":\"3883\"}],\"debit_cards\":[\"Mastercard Debit\",\"Visa Debit\"]}",
  "hotel_payment_methods": "[\"debit_card\", \"reward_points\"]",
  "hotel_membership_level": "Apex: Silver",
  "hotel_reward_points_balance": "Apex: 23054"
}

## GOAL
Follow these steps, one per message:
1. Ask for flights from Asheville to Syracuse departing on 2026-07-29 with a maximum price of $500.
2. After seeing the options, book flight FL683 for 1 passenger(s) under the name Sarah Miller, paying with credit card ending in 9696.
3. Once the flight is confirmed, search for hotels in Syracuse that have spa.
4. Check room availability at hotel H1054 for 1 guest(s) from 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-23.
5. Book room HR86469, paying with credit_card.
6. Once the hotel is confirmed, also search for bars in Syracuse that have happy hour (just for fun, no booking needed).
7. After seeing the bar results, ask to extend the hotel stay by one night -- change the check-out date to 2026-08-24.
8. Once the hotel is modified, cancel the flight reservation, giving the reason: Decided to drive back instead.
